name: Feeling lost
blurb: Messages for seasons of discouragement, grief and uncertainty.

videos.title: WHAT TO DO WHEN YOU ARE SAD,FRUSTRATED,DEPRESSED AND THINKING SUICIDE | APOSTLE JOSHUA SELMAN
videos.practice: Write one honest sentence beginning “Today I feel…” Beneath it, write “Even here, I am loved.” If words are hard to find, ask someone you trust to sit with you and read 1 John 3:1 aloud.

videos.title: IF YOU HAVE LOST YOUR SPIRITUAL FIRE,THEN YOU NEED TO WATCH THIS RIGHT AWAY | APOSTLE JOSHUA SELMAN
videos.practice: In Luke 15:17, the son pauses long enough to see where he is. Make room for that pause today. What is one small step toward home that you can actually take?

videos.title: WHEN YOUR HEART IS BROKEN AND TAKEN FOR GRANTED| APOSTLE JOSHUA SELMAN
videos.practice: Think of a time someone gave you room to change. Is there a relationship where you could offer that gift while keeping a boundary that matters?

videos.title: Hear this if you're Heartbroken - Apostle joshua selman
videos.practice: Read Acts 9:26–27. Barnabas saw a future for Saul that the frightened disciples could not yet see. Who has looked beyond a painful chapter in your story? Thank God for that person by name.

videos.title: WATCH THIS IF YOU ARE DISCOURAGED AND ABOUT TO GIVE UP | APOSTLE JOSHUA SELMAN
videos.practice: Read the short prayer in 1 Chronicles 4:10. If you had just one sentence to tell God what you need, what would it be? Write the honest version before you try to make it sound polished.

videos.title: (MUST WATCH) WHAT TO DO WHEN YOU ARE FRUSTRATED WITH LIFE||DON'T GIVE UP - Apostle Joshua Selman
videos.practice: When you compare two lives, you rarely see the waiting in both. Bring one comparison that stings into prayer. What would faithfulness look like in your own circumstances today?

videos.title: Your PAIN IS YOUR POWER; SUNDAY MORNING MESSAGE - APOSTLE JOSHUA SELMAN
videos.practice: Loss deserves to be named before anyone asks what it taught you. Name one thing you miss. Ask someone who knows the story to remember it with you.

videos.title: WHAT TO DO WHEN YOU FEEL YOU'RE LOSING HOPE IN LIFE - APOSTLE JOSHUA SELMAN
videos.practice: Read Mark 1:35. Jesus found a quiet place before the crowd began looking for him. Where could you set aside five minutes without having to be useful to anyone?

videos.title: WHAT TO DO WHEN DISCOURAGEMENT SETS INTO YOUR LIFE | APOSTLE JOSHUA SELMAN
videos.practice: Think of a task you kept doing faithfully while its outcome was uncertain. Who helped you keep going? Offer a prayer of thanks, then let that person hear your thanks too.

videos.title: LISTEN TO THIS DON'T BE WORRIED AND DEPRESSED | Apostle Joshua Selman
videos.practice: Rest and responsibility can share a day. Write down a worry, then name the one part of it you can act on. Ask for peace about what lies beyond that step.

videos.title: TRUSTING GOD IS NOT EASY: CHEER UP IF YOU HAVE BEEN CRYING - Apostle Joshua Selman
videos.practice: Recall a prayer whose answer is still unclear. Instead of guessing what the silence means, tell God what the waiting feels like. Let that be your whole prayer for a moment.

videos.title: IF YOU ALWAYS FIND YOURSELF CRYING DURING PRAYER HERE IS THE HIDDEN MEANING BY Apostle Joshua Selman
videos.practice: Read Psalm 56:8. If your prayer today comes as tears, what would it mean to believe that those tears are noticed? You do not have to explain each one.

videos.title: A DEEP CRY OF PRAYER TO GOD FOR MERCY AND DIVINE TURN AROUND | APOSTLE JOSHUA SELMAN
videos.practice: When you pray for a household under pressure, name a particular need. Could a meal, a call, or help with an application accompany your prayer for mercy?

videos.title: MUST LISTEN | ARE YOU IN PAIN | APOSTLE JOSHUA SELMAN
videos.practice: Name a place you associate with rejection. Imagine returning with a trusted friend beside you. What would you ask that friend to remember about your story?

videos.title: THE WEAPON AGAINST THE SPIRIT OF FEAR AND DEPRESSION - Apostle Joshua Selman
videos.practice: A rumour can start to feel like a verdict. Write down what you actually know and what you fear might happen. Bring both lists to God without confusing one for the other.

videos.title: APOSTLE JOSHUA SELMAN | WHAT TO DO WHEN ALL HOPE IS LOST
videos.practice: Read John 21:15–17. After Peter failed to keep his promise, Jesus gave him someone to care for. What small act of care is still open to you after disappointment?

videos.title: ARE YOU FEELING LOST OR CONFUSED IN LIFE - APOSTLE JOSHUA SELMAN
videos.practice: Which part of your life most needs wise guidance today? Ask one trustworthy person a specific question rather than trying to solve everything at once.

videos.title: HOW TO SOLVE ALL PROBLEMS | APOSTLE JOSHUA SELMAN
videos.practice: Choose one problem instead of carrying the whole list into this moment. Ask God for enough wisdom for the next decision and write down who might help you make it.

name: Morning Prayer
blurb: Begin the day with Scripture, intercession and thanksgiving.

videos.title: 6:45 AM #prayer 10 POWERFUL MORNING DECLARATIONS WITH APOSTLE JOSHUA SELMAN
videos.practice: Before the first appointment of the day, read Psalm 19:14. Which words do you want to practise today? Choose one sentence you can say sincerely to someone who needs encouragement.

videos.title: DECLARE THIS SCRIPTURES EVERY MORNING BEFORE GOING OUT WITH APOSTLE JOSHUA SELMAN
videos.practice: Choose one verse to carry through the door this morning. Read the verses around it too. What does the passage invite you to do when you arrive at your destination?

videos.title: 10 Minutes Powerful Morning Prayer Before You Start Your Day | Apostle Joshua Selman
videos.practice: Set aside ten quiet minutes. Give the first to gratitude and the last to listening. In between, speak plainly about the people and decisions on your mind.

videos.title: [MORNING PRAYER] SPEAK INTO YOUR DAY BEFORE THE ENEMY DOES - APOSTLE JOSHUA SELMAN
videos.practice: Notice the first prediction you made about today. Was it a fact or a fear? Turn it into a request: “God, when that moment comes, help me to…”

videos.title: Say This 15 Minutes Prayer & Watch Your Finances Skyrocket: Apostle Joshua Selman!
videos.practice: Read Matthew 6:11. What would “daily bread” mean in your household right now? Pray about that concrete need and consider one practical source of help or advice.

videos.title: Declare this prayer every morning and watch your life transform.. [Joshua Selman] #prayerworks
videos.practice: What changes when a prayer becomes a habit? Return to one short prayer for three mornings and notice whether it changes the way you attend to the people around you.

videos.title: 30 MINUTES MOST POWERFUL PSALM 120 MORNING PRAYER TO START YOUR DAY | APOSTLE JOSHUA SELMAN
videos.practice: Psalm 120 begins in distress and ends with a longing for peace. Is there a conversation in which you could refuse an unkind rumour today? Ask for the courage to do that quietly.

videos.title: ACTIVATING PRAYER MORNING BLESSINGS TO PROSPER AS YOU START YOUR DAY | APOSTLE JOSHUA SELMAN
videos.practice: Picture the work waiting for you today. Where would a blessing be felt most: in patience, a fair decision, or enough to share? Ask for that particular good.

videos.title: DECLARE THIS 20 MINUTES VIOLENT PRAYER EVERY MORNING BEFORE GOING OUT - APOSTLE JOSHUA SELMAN
videos.practice: Bring one strong feeling into prayer without directing it at another person. Read Ephesians 6:12, then ask what a firm and peaceable response could look like today.

videos.title: 30 MINUTES MOST POWERFUL PSALM 121 MORNING PRAYER TO START YOUR DAY | APOSTLE JOSHUA SELMAN
videos.practice: Read Psalm 121:1–2 slowly. On the next familiar stretch of your journey, look up from the path. What reminds you that you do not have to be your own only source of help?

videos.title: MORNING PRAYERS: COMMANDING THE DAY MORNING PRAYER || APOSTLE JOSHUA SELMAN
videos.practice: Before directing the day, notice what you cannot direct: another person’s mood, a delay, an unexpected need. Ask God for a faithful response to one interruption.

videos.title: Start Your Day Right: Command Your Morning with Powerful Prayers! | Apostle Joshua Selman
videos.practice: What would starting well mean if the day did not go to plan? Choose a way of treating people that you can keep even when the timetable changes.

videos.title: COMMANDING YOUR MORNING TO DELIVER BY APOSTLE JOSHUA SELMAN
videos.practice: Look at today’s calendar. Beside one obligation, write the good you hope it will bring to someone else. Make that person, rather than the task, the focus of a short prayer.

videos.title: (POWERFUL 🔥) 10 MINUTES of POWERFUL PROPHETIC DECLARATIONS by Apostle Joshua Selman Nimmak
videos.practice: Which words in your morning prayer also ask something of you? If you pray for reconciliation, for example, consider whether you owe someone a first kind word.

videos.title: Start Your Day With Powerful Declarations | Learn To Use This Secret Daily | Apostle Joshua Selman
videos.practice: Read Lamentations 3:22–23. Recall one mercy from yesterday that you might otherwise forget. Let that memory shape the first words you say about today.

videos.title: Command Your Morning 🌅 | Powerful Breakthrough Prayers by Apostle Joshua Selman
videos.practice: Name the closed door on your mind. While you wait for it to open, what useful thing can you do on this side of it? Offer that act to God today.

videos.title: GOD OF SARAH, DO FOR ME WHAT MEN SAY IS IMPOSSIBLE | POWERFUL MORNING PRAYER | APOSTLE JOSHUA SELMAN
videos.practice: Read Genesis 18:12–14. Sarah’s laughter belongs in the story alongside the promise. What hope feels difficult even to say out loud? Bring your hesitation into the prayer too.

videos.title: [Tuesday 25th November,2025]Start Your Tuesday With Prayer Spiritual Prayer By Apostle Joshua Selman
videos.practice: A date passes, but the people we prayed for on that day still have lives unfolding. Return to an old prayer list and ask one person how things are now.

videos.title: Pray until it manifests || Apostle Joshua Selman
videos.practice: Read Luke 18:1. When repeating a request grows tiring, who could share the praying with you? Tell that person what you hope for without setting a deadline.

videos.title: START YOUR DAY WITH THIS POWERFUL EARLY MORNING PRAYER || APOSTLE JOSHUA SELMAN
videos.practice: At the first quiet moment, name one gift you did nothing to earn. Carry that gratitude into the first ordinary chore of the day.

videos.title: Say These Blessings Everyday in the Morning🔥- Apostle Joshua Selman
videos.practice: Think of a blessing you often ask for yourself. Pray it for someone whose day is harder than yours, then see whether you can offer them some part of it.

videos.title: Command Your Morning with Power | Apostle Joshua Selman
videos.practice: Strength sometimes looks like restraint. Where might you need the power to listen to the end of a sentence before deciding what to say back?

videos.title: Command Your Tuesday! Prophetic Morning Prayers | Apostle Joshua Selman
videos.practice: Choose one ordinary weekday routine as a cue for prayer. When the kettle boils or the bus arrives, name someone you want to remember before the day gets busy.

videos.title: PSALM 91 + 35: TOTAL Spiritual Cleansing of Your Home — Every Evil Force Is Broken NOW!
videos.practice: Read Psalm 91:1–2. Think of a place where someone helped you feel safe. What could you do to make your own home more restful for the next person who enters?

videos.title: Every Evil Food in the Dream – Be Consumed by Fire! Midnight Deliverance with Apostle Joshua Selman
videos.practice: If a troubling dream stays with you, take a moment to notice where you are now. Read Psalm 4:8 and tell God what frightened you without treating the dream as a verdict.

videos.title: FATHER GOD, THANK YOU FOR THE GIFT OF A NEW DAY | APOSTLE JOSHUA SELMAN
videos.practice: Thank God for something specific enough that only you could name it: a familiar laugh, a meal someone saved, or a message that arrived in time. Who else deserves your thanks?

videos.title: GOD OF THE ELEVENTH HOUR - NOTHING MISSING, NOTHING BROKEN || APOSTLE JOSHUA SELMAN
videos.practice: Read Matthew 20:6–9. Think of someone still waiting to be included late in the day. Is there an invitation you could extend while there is still time?

videos.title: Pray This Prayer Between 12:00AM - 3AM For Full Restoration Of Your Destiny | Apostle Joshua Selman
videos.practice: When you find yourself awake at night, a short prayer is enough. Name what you long to see restored and allow yourself to rest without solving it before morning.

videos.title: LORD, TAKE OVER THE BATTLES I DO NOT UNDERSTAND | APOSTLE JOSHUA SELMAN
videos.practice: Draw a line between what is yours to do and what is beyond your understanding. Pray for wisdom on the first side and the freedom to ask for help on the second.
